svg.title: Price per million tokens, Q2 2026
svg.desc: Paired bars built from one-dollar tiles show input and output prices per million tokens for four models: GPT-5.4 Nano at $0.20 and $1.25, Claude Haiku 4.5 at $1 and $5, Claude Sonnet 4.6 at $3 and $15, and Claude Opus 4.7 at $5 and $25. Output costs five to six times input on every model; Opus is marked at 5×.
